preregistered_plan.goal: Compute lowest physical modes of the unchanged native pinned PFFDTD rigid Neumann graph on ALL five frozen original PPW28-44 meshes and couple the original unaltered eight-node q0 source/receiver; compare native leapfrog discrete frequencies and signed 0.25-second modal impulse transfer with frozen full native 40/80Hz data. Diagnostic, not qualification.

source_authority.raw_source: unchanged original native 8-node sim comms impulse, q[0]=1 and n>0=0, source scale l2/h and out_alpha trilinear receiver

spectral_problem.matrix: exact pinned original native seven-point rigid graph of -L on source-connected interior room only; degree minus full reciprocal one-step adjacency; graph indices C ordered
spectral_problem.solve: scipy.sparse.linalg.eigsh(A,k=20,which=SM,tol=1e-9,maxiter=6000,ncv=60) CPU sparse symmetric Krylov; zero constant mode included
spectral_problem.leapfrog_native_eigenfrequencies_hz: f_native=asin(sqrt(l2*lambda_graph)/2)/(pi*Ts), with native Ts and l2, real stable 0<= l2*lambda <=4
spectral_problem.original_receiver_source_eigen_overlap: normalized original 8-node alpha and source pulse distribution (native source signals first step divided by original total scaling), projected onto Euclidean unit eigenvector; signed product is invariant under eigenvector sign
spectral_problem.modal_impulse: u[n]=source_scale*sum_k (dot(vk,receiver)*dot(vk,source)) sin(n*theta_k)/sin(theta_k) for n>=1; zero theta uses n; source_scale native total in_sigs[0] sum; u[0]=0; phi native output emitted before n-step source update
spectral_problem.pressure_derivative: existing unchanged htdt acoustic_pffdtd_adapter.pffdtd_velocity_potential_to_pressure_trace; exact native second order derivative on 0.25s Nt samples; no taper; finite P_T/Q_T q0 unit, signed 40/80Hz
spectral_problem.numerical_provenance: each eigenvector true residual and modal signed individual finite-window transfer at 40/80 preserved; retain small/large and negative/error findings

limits.if_memory_or_convergence_fails: store complete explicit failure for level, do not forge or silently omit mode; diagnostic incomplete
